definitions.explanation: The quality of remaining constant and unchanging over time.
In biology, the ability of an organism to maintain stable internal conditions (such as body temperature, blood sugar, etc.) despite changes in the external environment.

examples.japanese: {品質|ひんしつ}の{恒常性|こうじょうせい}を{保|たも}つ。
{市場|しじょう}の{恒常性|こうじょうせい}は{経済|けいざい}の{安定|あんてい}にとって{重要|じゅうよう}だ。
examples.english: Market constancy is important for economic stability.

examples.japanese: {供給|きょうきゅう}の{恒常性|こうじょうせい}が{失|うしな}われると、{消費者|しょうひしゃ}の{信頼|しんらい}も{低下|ていか}する。
examples.english: When supply constancy is lost, consumer trust also declines.

examples.japanese: {体温|たいおん}の{恒常性|こうじょうせい}は{生命|せいめい}{維持|いじ}に{不可欠|ふかけつ}だ。
examples.english: Homeostasis of body temperature is essential for sustaining life.

examples.japanese: {人体|じんたい}は{恒常性|こうじょうせい}を{維持|いじ}するために、さまざまな{調節|ちょうせつ}{機能|きのう}が{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: Various regulatory functions work to maintain homeostasis in the human body.

examples.japanese: {血糖値|けっとうち}の{恒常性|こうじょうせい}が{崩|くず}れると、{糖尿病|とうにょうびょう}などの{病気|びょうき}を{引|ひ}き{起|お}こすことがある。
examples.english: When homeostasis of blood sugar levels is disrupted, it can lead to diseases such as diabetes.

notes:
A compound of {恒常|こうじょう} (permanent, constant) and {性|せい} (nature, quality). In biology, this is the standard Japanese translation of "homeostasis" — the concept that living organisms actively regulate their internal environment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {恒常性|こうじょうせい}を{維持|いじ}する: to maintain homeostasis/constancy
- {恒常性|こうじょうせい}が{崩|くず}れる: homeostasis breaks down
- {恒常性|こうじょうせい}の{維持|いじ}: maintenance of homeostasis
- {体内|たいない}{恒常性|こうじょうせい}: internal homeostasis

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ホメオスタシス: homeostasis — the direct loanword from English, used in scientific contexts
- {安定性|あんていせい}: stability — more general term for being stable
- {一定|いってい}: constant, fixed — describes something staying at a set level
